description.en: The ID of the CEN instance.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样。
description.en:
A token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate this token from your client, but you must ensure it is unique for each request. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the request's **RequestId** as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** is unique for each API request.
The ID of the network instance.
The payer for the network instance.

descriptions.zh: ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter接口仅支持编辑转发路由器实例连接跨账号专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例、边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）实例、IPsec实例的资费承担方。
descriptions.en: You can use this operation to modify the payer for a cross-account connection to a transit router, but only if the connected network instance is a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), virtual border router (VBR), or IPsec instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn modify-grant-instance-to-transit-router --cen-id cen-dc4vwznpwbobrl0000 --instance-id vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000 --order-type PayByCenOwner --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
